Painters in Bondi

Coastal paint fails fast. We build finishes that don't.

Bondi salt air is hard on paint. You've seen it. Render that chalks and flakes within a couple of summers. Timber trims that lift at the edges. Rust bleeding through balcony rails, and a facade that looked sharp two years ago and now looks tired.

That's not bad luck. It's the Tasman Sea, throwing salt spray, heavy UV and wind-driven rain at your walls every single day. A quick cheap repaint just hides it for a season.

We're Sydney Paintmasters. For over 20 years we've painted houses, apartments and strata blocks across Bondi and the Eastern Suburbs, and we prep and coat them for the coast, not for a sheltered inland street. That means proper washing, sanding and sealing, corrosion-resistant primers on metal, and flexible weather-grade topcoats that move with the surface instead of cracking off it. The result lasts. That's the whole point.

Every job is fully licensed and insured, quoted at a fixed price with no call-out fee, and run by a team that turns up when we say we will. Simple as that.

props.label: Five steps from quote to clean-up
props.html:
Our Process

Five steps from quote to clean-up

No mystery, no vague timelines. Here's exactly how a Bondi repaint runs with us.

Most residential jobs move quickly once we start. We'll give you a realistic timeframe at the quote stage and keep you posted if the weather forces a change, which on the coast it sometimes does.

1

Free quote and colour chat

We visit the property, assess the surfaces and salt exposure, talk colours, and send a clear fixed-price quote.

2

Surface prep

Pressure wash, scrape, sand, fill and repair. Rust treated, gaps sealed, everything primed ready to coat.

3

Protection and masking

Floors, furniture, glass, gardens and neighbours' cars protected before any paint goes near a wall.

4

Coating

Two or more coats of coastal-grade paint, applied evenly, with the right dry time between each pass.

5

Final check and clean-up

We walk the job with you, touch up anything you flag, clear the site, and you sign off happy.

props.label: Straight answers, no runaround
props.html:
Bondi Painting FAQs

Straight answers, no runaround

How much does a painter cost in Bondi?
It depends on the size of the job, the surfaces and how much prep the paint needs. We quote every Bondi job at a fixed price after a free site visit, so you know the full number before we start. No call-out fee, no obligation to go ahead.
How often should I repaint a coastal home in Bondi?
Exterior paint on a Bondi home usually needs attention sooner than an inland one because salt air and UV break coatings down faster. As a rough guide, a well-prepped coastal exterior lasts several years, and beachfront-facing walls sometimes less. We'll tell you honestly what yours needs at the quote.
What paint holds up best to Bondi salt air?
Flexible, weather-resistant exterior systems paired with corrosion-resistant primers on metal. The primer and prep matter as much as the topcoat out here. We match the product to the surface and the sea exposure rather than using one paint for everything.
How do you prep exterior surfaces for the coast?
Pressure wash to strip salt and grime, scrape and sand back failing paint, treat any rust, fill and repair damage, then prime. Skipping prep is the number one reason coastal paint jobs fail early. We don't skip it.
Do you paint Art Deco apartments and Federation homes in Bondi?
Yes. Bondi has a lot of Art Deco apartment stock and Federation character homes, and they need a careful hand. We protect original features, select period-sensitive colours, and prep detailed surfaces properly so the character stays intact.
Do you do strata and unit-block painting in Bondi?
We do. Common areas, facades, balconies and interiors for Bondi strata and unit blocks. We schedule around residents, keep disruption low, and communicate clearly with the strata manager or committee throughout.
How long does an exterior repaint take in Bondi?
A typical house exterior runs a handful of days depending on size, prep and weather. Coastal weather can push timing, so we build a realistic window into the quote and keep you posted if rain or wind moves things.
Are you licensed and insured?
Yes. We hold Painter Decorator Licence 315254C and carry full insurance on every job. Ask us and we'll show you.
Do you offer free quotes and fixed prices?
Every quote is free and fixed-price. The number we give you is the number you pay, with no call-out fee. If the scope changes because you add work, we'll agree that with you first.
What brands of paint do you use?
Quality trade products from established brands like Dulux, matched to your surfaces and the coastal exposure. If you have a preferred brand or colour system, tell us and we'll work with it.
Can you paint in winter, or is it a summer job?
We paint year-round. Cooler months are fine for exteriors as long as conditions are dry enough for coats to cure. We watch the forecast and plan around wet, windy days rather than pushing paint onto damp surfaces.
Do you paint roofs and pool surfaces in Bondi?
Yes. We handle roof cleaning, sealing and recoating, plus specialist pool surface coatings. Both need the right prep and product for coastal conditions, which is squarely what we do.
What other suburbs near Bondi do you cover?
Alongside Bondi we paint across Bronte, Dover Heights, Queens Park, Tamarama and Waverley, plus the wider Eastern Suburbs. If you're nearby and not listed, just ask.
What are your hours and how fast can you start?
We work 6am to 6pm Monday to Saturday and we're closed Sundays. Site visits are usually available the same week. Call 0423 019 087 and we'll book you in.

acceptedAnswer.text: It depends on the size of the job, the surfaces and how much prep the paint needs. We quote every Bondi job at a fixed price after a free site visit, so you know the full number before we start. No call-out fee, no obligation to go ahead.

mainEntity.name: How often should I repaint a coastal home in Bondi?

acceptedAnswer.text: Exterior paint on a Bondi home usually needs attention sooner than an inland one because salt air and UV break coatings down faster. As a rough guide, a well-prepped coastal exterior lasts several years, and beachfront-facing walls sometimes less. We'll tell you honestly what yours needs at the quote.

mainEntity.name: What paint holds up best to Bondi salt air?

acceptedAnswer.text: Flexible, weather-resistant exterior systems paired with corrosion-resistant primers on metal. The primer and prep matter as much as the topcoat out here. We match the product to the surface and the sea exposure rather than using one paint for everything.

mainEntity.name: How do you prep exterior surfaces for the coast?

acceptedAnswer.text: Pressure wash to strip salt and grime, scrape and sand back failing paint, treat any rust, fill and repair damage, then prime. Skipping prep is the number one reason coastal paint jobs fail early. We don't skip it.

mainEntity.name: Do you paint Art Deco apartments and Federation homes in Bondi?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Bondi has a lot of Art Deco apartment stock and Federation character homes, and they need a careful hand. We protect original features, select period-sensitive colours, and prep detailed surfaces properly so the character stays intact.

mainEntity.name: Do you do strata and unit-block painting in Bondi?

acceptedAnswer.text: We do. Common areas, facades, balconies and interiors for Bondi strata and unit blocks. We schedule around residents, keep disruption low, and communicate clearly with the strata manager or committee throughout.

mainEntity.name: How long does an exterior repaint take in Bondi?

acceptedAnswer.text: A typical house exterior runs a handful of days depending on size, prep and weather. Coastal weather can push timing, so we build a realistic window into the quote and keep you posted if rain or wind moves things.
